$comment: Generated. Every entry is a repair that was actually applied on a business PC. Do not remove entries.

repairs.title: Add financial correction audit tables and payment void columns
repairs.description: Creates financial_correction_audits and admin_verification_logs, and adds the void columns to payment_allocations.
repairs.detectionQuery: SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='payment_allocations' AND column_name='voidedAt'
repairs.verificationQuery: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='payment_allocations' AND column_name IN ('voidedAt', 'voidedById', 'correctionId')

repairs.title: Add the AUTO label barcode source
repairs.description: Adds the AUTO value to the LabelBarcodeSource enum. Separate from the repair that uses it because PostgreSQL cannot use a new enum value in the transaction that added it.
repairs.detectionQuery: SELECT 1 FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid WHERE t.typname = 'LabelBarcodeSource' AND e.enumlabel = 'AUTO'
repairs.verificationQuery: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid WHERE t.typname = 'LabelBarcodeSource' AND e.enumlabel = 'AUTO'

repairs.title: Prefer saved product barcodes on labels
repairs.description: Makes AUTO the label barcode default and flips SKU-defaulted products that already have a barcode. Runs after product-label-auto-enum.
repairs.detectionQuery: SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='products' AND column_name='labelBarcodeSource' AND column_default LIKE '%AUTO%'
repairs.verificationQuery: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='products' AND column_name='labelBarcodeSource' AND column_default LIKE '%AUTO%'

repairs.verificationQuery: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND indexname IN ('products_name_norm_trgm_idx','products_model_norm_trgm_idx','products_brand_norm_trgm_idx','products_sku_norm_trgm_idx','products_barcode_norm_trgm_idx','products_notes_norm_trgm_idx','products_specification_notes_norm_trgm_idx','products_specifications_norm_trgm_idx')

repairs.title: Add weekly installments and customer notes/address search
repairs.description: Adds WEEKLY to InstallmentPlanFrequency and the normalized trigram indexes for customer notes and address search. Covers migrations 20260806093135 and 20260806101225.
repairs.detectionQuery: SELECT 1 WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid WHERE t.typname='InstallmentPlanFrequency' AND e.enumlabel='WEEKLY') = 1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND indexname IN ('customers_notes_norm_trgm_idx','customers_address_norm_trgm_idx')) = 2
repairs.verificationQuery: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid WHERE t.typname='InstallmentPlanFrequency' AND e.enumlabel='WEEKLY') + (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND indexname IN ('customers_notes_norm_trgm_idx','customers_address_norm_trgm_idx')))::int AS count
